description: Cases every implementation of nemar.sensor-labels.v1 reproduces. Each case lists a recording's channels as [name, BIDS type or null] in recording order, and the result: the outcome, the refusal reason, the montage, the counts, the contending montages, the duplicated electrodes, and per channel its status, its normalized key and the montage electrode it is placed on. The montages are views/montages with the SHA-256 digests listed here.

cases.name: ten_twenty
cases.description: The 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system, with modern names.

cases.name: ten_twenty_legacy_names
cases.description: T3, T4, T5 and T6 are the ACNS aliases of T7, T8, P7 and P8.

cases.name: legacy_and_modern_name_together
cases.description: T3 and T7 name one electrode, so two channels map to it.

cases.name: edf_prefix_and_reference
cases.description: European Data Format (EDF) style names with an EEG prefix and a reference suffix; a typed ECG channel and an untyped photic channel are excluded and not counted.

cases.name: eeg_prefix_variants
cases.description: Each separator after the EEG prefix is stripped; EEG directly followed by a letter or a digit is not a prefix.

cases.name: trailing_dots_untyped
cases.description: Untyped names padded with dots to four characters.

cases.name: quotes_whitespace_unicode
cases.description: Quotation marks, surrounding whitespace, a no-break space and full-width characters normalize to the plain name; a space inside a name stays, so P 4 matches nothing.

cases.name: common_reference_suffix
cases.description: Every name but the reference's carries -Cz: the shared suffix is the recording's reference and is stripped.

cases.name: common_reference_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: Nine of ten hyphenated names end in -Cz (90%): Cz is the reference, and the tenth, O1-F7, is a bipolar pair.

cases.name: common_reference_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: Eight of ten hyphenated names end in -Cz (80%): no common reference, so every hyphenated name is a bipolar pair.

cases.name: common_reference_on_most_names
cases.description: Ten of 19 names end in -Cz: hyphenated names are most of the names, so -Cz is the reference.

cases.name: common_reference_on_half_the_names
cases.description: Nine of 18 names end in -Cz: hyphenated names are not most of the names, so they are bipolar pairs.

cases.name: reference_names
cases.description: Each reference name after the last hyphen is stripped; a name with two hyphens splits at the last, so Fpz-Fz-Ref keeps fpz-fz and matches nothing.

cases.name: single_bipolar_among_unipolar
cases.description: One hyphenated name among unipolar ones is a bipolar pair, not a reference scheme: it stays unplaced and the rest are placed.

cases.name: bipolar_double_banana
cases.description: A clinical bipolar montage: every name is a pair of electrodes.

cases.name: numeric_labels
cases.description: Numbered channels name no electrode.

cases.name: share_too_low
cases.description: 12 of 16 names match (75%).

cases.name: share_at_threshold
cases.description: 12 of 15 names match (80%, the threshold).

cases.name: too_few_channels
cases.description: Seven candidate channels.

cases.name: too_few_matched
cases.description: Seven of eight names match: the share passes, the count does not.

cases.name: eight_matched
cases.description: Eight names, all matched (the minimum).

cases.name: excluded_channels_not_counted
cases.description: Typed non-EEG channels and untyped names with a non-EEG prefix are excluded and not counted; an EEG-typed name with such a prefix is a candidate.

cases.name: fiducials_dropped
cases.description: Fiducial names are not electrodes and are not counted.

cases.name: vref_outside_egi_nets
cases.description: VREF is Cz only on an EGI net, so on the 10-05 montage it stays unplaced.

cases.name: egi_129
cases.description: An EGI 128-channel net with its vertex reference (E1 to E128 and Cz). The 257 net holds the same names, but the 129 net, of the same family and smaller, holds every name the 257 net matched.

cases.name: egi_129_zeros_and_vref
cases.description: Zero-padded numbers and VREF for the vertex reference.

cases.name: egi_128
cases.description: E1 to E128: the 129, 256 and 257 nets hold every name the 128 net matched and are larger nets of its family, so they do not contend.

cases.name: egi_e129
cases.description: E1 to E129, as many EGI exports name a 129-channel net: E129 is Cz on the 129 net. The 256 and 257 nets hold E129 as an electrode of their own, but the 129 net, of the same family and smaller, matches every channel they match.

cases.name: egi_e129_and_cz
cases.description: E129 and Cz are one electrode on the 129 net.

cases.name: egi_duplicate_after_zeros
cases.description: E001 and E1 are one electrode.

cases.name: egi_257
cases.description: A 256-channel net with its vertex reference.

cases.name: egi_256
cases.description: E1 to E256: the 257 net holds no name the 256 net lacks.

cases.name: egi_65
cases.description: The 64-channel net, version 1.0, with its vertex reference.

cases.name: egi_64
cases.description: E1 to E64.

cases.name: egi_e257
cases.description: E1 to E257: E257 is Cz on the 257 net.

cases.name: egi_e65
cases.description: E1 to E65: E65 is Cz on the 65 net. E65 is an electrode of the 128, 129, 256 and 257 nets, which the 65 net dismisses.

cases.name: egi_prefix_of_128
cases.description: E1 to E100: the 128 net holds every name, but 100 is below 90% of its 128 electrodes, so the names may come from a cap this algorithm does not list.

cases.name: egi_prefix_of_64
cases.description: E1 to E40: 40 of the 64 net's electrodes.

cases.name: egi_duplicate_on_a_partial_net
cases.description: E1 to E100 and E001: a duplicate is reported before the coverage.

cases.name: egi_e1_to_e28
cases.description: E1 to E28: the 32 net and the BioSemi 160 E bank both hold the names; an ambiguity is reported before the 32 net's coverage (28 of 33).

cases.name: egi_129_twelve_dropped
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz with twelve electrodes dropped: 117 of 129 is at least 90% of the net.

cases.name: egi_129_thirteen_dropped
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz with thirteen electrodes dropped: 116 of 129 is below 90% of the net.

cases.name: biosemi_160_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to D32 and E1 to E16: 144 of the BioSemi 160 cap's electrodes, exactly 90%.

cases.name: biosemi_160_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to D32 and E1 to E15: 143 of 160.

cases.name: egi_e33_ambiguous_with_biosemi_e_bank
cases.description: E1 to E33: E33 is Cz on the 32 net, which matches all 33 names, but the BioSemi 160 cap's E bank matches E1 to E32 (97%) on other positions.

cases.name: egi_32_ambiguous_with_biosemi_e_bank
cases.description: E1 to E32 and Cz: the BioSemi 160 cap's E bank matches 32 of the 33 names (97%), on other positions, so the names do not identify a net.

cases.name: biosemi_128
cases.description: A BioSemi 128 cap (A1 to D32) with external and status channels left untyped. The 160 and 256 caps hold the same names; the 128 cap, of the same family and smaller, holds every name they matched.

cases.name: biosemi_160
cases.description: A BioSemi 160 cap (A1 to E32).

cases.name: biosemi_256
cases.description: A BioSemi 256 cap (A1 to H32).

cases.name: ten_five_or_biosemi
cases.description: A1, A2 and C1 to C6 are 10-05 names and BioSemi names on other positions: the two families tie.

cases.name: runner_up_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: 18 names are both 10-05 and BioSemi 256 names; with Fz and Cz the 10-05 montage matches 20 and the BioSemi 256 cap 18 (90%, a contender).

cases.name: runner_up_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: With Pz as well the 10-05 montage matches 21 and the BioSemi 256 cap 18 (86%, not a contender).
